unit: United States calendar month, seasonally adjusted published national aggregate

fields.period: M01 to M12 month; M13 annual average is excluded if present
fields.value: published rate in percent, one decimal place
fields.LNS14000000: civilian unemployment rate, Current Population Survey
fields.JTS000000000000000JOR: total nonfarm job-openings rate, Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey

coverage: 2001-01 through 2024-12; 288 paired monthly observations; 2020-2021 excluded only from analysis windows
limitations: Two survey estimates with sampling and nonsampling error; historical BLS values can be revised. Snapshot is not an original respondent-level dataset.
